content:
Key
Value
admin_count
Current number of admins in the account.
GET  /admin/v1/info/summary
edition
Current edition (including trials) of the
account.
integration_count
Current number of integrations in the
account.
telephony_credits_remaining
Current total number of telephony credits
available in the account. This is the sum of all
types of telephony credits.
user_count
Current number of users in the account.
user_pending_deletion_count
Current number of users pending deletion
from the account (seen in the Admin Panel's
Trash view).
